notes.title: Update Coming soon
notes.content:
Panzarians, 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5323408/9d14243dc61bb9f9c29f1021a6bc6b3c7861b079.jpg[/img]

Summer is the time of travel and discovery. That's why we at Panzar Studio are working hard to ensure that this summer you can go to unique, previously unknown places. Soon, a patch will be installed on the Panzar server, adding new locations for the PvP and PvE modes.

Do you hear? With a heavy ringing, the Iron Blacksmith's hammer descends on the anvil, linking behind the link creating the reasons for the war. A croak of Crom scrape with a shovel, burying treasure among the rocks, hoping that no one will ever get to his riches.

Mysterious creatures, called or created by dark sorcery, lie in wait for the travelers behind each turn, ready at any moment to rush into the attack. Here they believe only in steel and fire, they rely only on themselves and proven combat comrades. They do not expect favors from the gods, because the gods have long turned into monsters.

Yes, this world is full of dangers, but its map grows, becomes more extensive and more detailed, and real seekers of adventure can not stay at home at all - they are called for the threshold of untrod-den trails, picturesque spaces, the noise of battles and the shine of treasures. All this will be in abundance in the prepared locations, and we hope that you will appreciate them on their merits.

notes.title: Update 44 : New Horizon
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976761998.jpg[/img]

Upgrade №44 safely installed. All those who missed the previous brutal and horrible persons of their characters, rejoice! Faces, face and Hari returned to the original state and now they again can be frightening to young children hiccups and impressionable young men (which we strongly recommend you do not)! Of course, this does not concern persons beautiful elves, who chose to remain with the updated appearance. More information about these and other changes you can read in a special section on our website. Do not lose face, play PANZAR! 

Introduced a system of levels for a user account: with each new level increases the number of bonuses, including VIP-activated subscription. 
Account level depends on the amount purchased by the user crystals. 
Bonuses: 
Regular bonuses: 
• Additional experience accrued to all participants of the fight. The amount of experience depends on the level. 
• Discount when buying crystals. The size depends on the level. 
• Additional slots chests. The number of slots depends on the level. 
• Reset skills. 
• The ability to rename your character. 
• Gift for the character. 
• Gift for the account. 

Bonuses with active VIP-account: 
• Accelerated development of the character. It depends on the level. 
• Automatically improve things. 
• The chance to get a key from the large trunk. 
• Accelerated development of Weapons of Victory. It depends on the level. 
• The chance to get a key from Epic Chest. 
• Unlimited change of daily quests. 

Added special window VIP-level account that appears after clicking on the icon of the crystals. 
Purchase VIP-account can now be in the first section of the tab "Objects" in-game store. 
From the contents of a large trunk deleted object "Pearl Pendant". Now it is used as a unique gift for raising the level of your account. 
With an increase in the level of each account tied to it the character receives gifts. This also applies to newly created characters. 
At the character selection screen appears the "Gift characters", equipped with a special counter. When you click on the field, then the process of free creation of gift character level 30. Speed up the process you can use for maximizing account level. 
Icons indicating the account level are displayed in the following locations: 
• In standby table battle 
• The tab menu in action 
• In the frame profile 

Changed the mechanism of the VIP-akkaunta button in the main menu: 
• When you click on a player it moves to the store section "VIP-account" tab "Objects" 
• painted in orange, while not active with active VIP-account letters "VIP" - gray 
• Changed the icon VIP-account

notes.title: Patch Notes 43.5
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[img]http://www.panzar.com/Content/images/patch.png[/img]

[list]
[*]We've fixed a bug due to which players in the queue were not always displayed

[*]All maps now have the same light balance. The brightness value do not change on different scenes, and the "dim" effect is equally dim everywhere
[*]The frames of the "Magical Shield" have become thinner and no longer catch shadows from other objects
[*]Coloring of Paladins is now more homogeneous
[*]Ice that appears when the "Winter Cold" effects are applied to a character has become more transparent
[*]Explosions from Frozen Spheres and Fire Balls have become directed and decreased in size
[*]We've also reduced the brightness of all other effects
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 43 Recents Changes Summary
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[img]http://www.panzar.com/Content/images/patch.png[/img]

Patch 43.1
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug due to which a character did not receive experience for using the "Magical Shield" skill
[*]We fixed problems with the "awesomium" processes that caused the decline of performance and FPS
[*]A tablet with a message about low FPS now appears only when a really significant decrease of FPS occurs
[*]Fixed a bug due to which it was necessary to wait for the cooling of the cannon after installing the "Krom's Fiery Rage"
[/list]

Patch 43.2
[list]
[*]The amount of experience gained for applying the "Totem" skill is reduced by 10%
[*]Now the DoT-effect from the "Lacerated Wounds" ability is activated even if the victim is blocking at the moment of impact
[*]Fixed a bug due to which "Chimera Ash" affected bosses and minibosses at PvE locations
[*]The difficulty has been corrected on the Sunset Island (Hard) and Midnight Island (Very Hard) in the PvE mode
[*]Now, all players have a zero rating of Battle Value
[*]Now the number of Paladins in a team is limited to two
[*]We fixed a bug that prevented the opening of items available for crafting
[/list]
Patch 43.3
[list]
[*]There is some kind of makeup in the game. It's already available in the store, looks like a paper bag and can effectively hide the face of your character.
[*]Now character's health is reduced by 8% instead of 9% for 1 stack of the "Berserker Rage" skill
[/list]
Patch 43.4
[list]
[*]The amount of experience gained for the use of the "Siren Scream " ability has been reduced by 15%
[*]Now experience can be gained for healing an ally with the "Second Wind" skill
[*]Damage dealt by the Berserker's "Finishing Blow" has been increased by 5%
[*]The amount of experience gained for the use of the "Incense Of Quickening" ability has been increased by 15%
[*]The duration of the "Ring of Immortality" skill has been reduced from 10 to 8 seconds
[*]The "Ring of Immortality" radius has been reduced from 9.5 to 7.5 meters
[*]The range of the "Resurrection" skill has been reduced from 10.5 to 7.5 meters
[*]Recovery time for "Resurrection" has been increased from 45 to 60 seconds.
[*]The number of Will Points received for the use of the "Arquebus Mastery" skill has been reduced from 2 to 1
[*]The visual display for the "Battle Fervour" skill of Sister of Fire has been added
[*]We also fixed a bug due to which the characters who were under the effect of the "Seven-league Boots" skill, could not run on an enemy's Glare Ice
[*]Fixed a bug due to which the Incense Of Quickening did not increase the speed of the Paladin who used it
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 42
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[list]
[*]The maximum number of player in a group/party has been reduced from 8 to 3
[*]PvE mode has been completely redesigned, the size of a PvE party has reduced from 6 to 5 players
[*]Added a special chest, which can only be received on PvE locations
[*]A new type of tutorial has been added team against bots (for characters lvl 5-10)
[*]Introduction of Daily quests for both PvP and PvE modes
[*]Posebility to view broadcasts through the game client has been added
[*]New banners, emblems and accessories have been added
[*]Thematical thrones for the characters have been added, with a possibility to use them in battle.
[*]Numerical values now clearly show how much each parameter of an item is improved. You can seen it during the auto upgrade process.
[*]Decorative shields for Tanks and censers for Paladins have been added
[*]Now the equipment items (including bottles of elixirs and banners) do not interact with a character. They will not interfere with characters' movements or the construction of dwarven constructions
[*]Skills, such as "Glare Ice," "Sky Fire" and "Holy Fire", from allies are highlighted in blue and the effects of corresponding from the enemy skills - in red
[*]Access to a large number of previously inaccessible places on different maps is much easier now
[*]Now you can remove the "basic ability" from the slot on the HUD-panel and replace it with any other skill on a player's choice.
[*]When receiving a medal for the successful completion of a PvE it will brings a player some loot
[*]Now you can change abilities during the battle without waiting for the death of a character
[*]We've changed prizes for the Wheel Of the Four Gods: amulets will be replaced by keys for standard chests in an amountfrom one to five, depending on the number of days in a row played by a user [/list]

Skills & Abilities:

Ice Witch:                                                          
[list]                                                                                                                                     
[*]The aiming mechanism of the "Winter Cold" skill has been changed - now the Ice Witch freezes enemies only in front of her
[*]But we've added opportunity to move around while using the "Winter Cold" ability
[*]The amount of energy required for the use of the ability to "Frozen Sphere" has been reduced from 15 to 1 units
[*]And yes, we've added opportunity to move around while using the "Frozen Sphere" skill
[*]Amount of class points for a successful hit by the "Frozen Orb" has been reduced by 15%
[*]We've changed the "Second Wind" skill - no the Ice Witch regenerates herself and allies who are in close proximity
[*]Now the "Siren Scream" ability inflicts damage on frozen mechanisms
[*]The amount of energy needed to activate the "Freeze" ability, has been reduced from 20 to 15 units [/list]

Sister Of Fire:
                                       
[list]
[*]The "Meditation" ability has been removed
[*]Instead, we've added new skill "Battle Fervor" - Sister Of Fire significantly increases her attack speed, at the same time reducing the damage done
[*]Also, we've changed skill "Second Wind" - now Sister Of Fire regenerates herself and allies who are in close proximity
[*]And yes, we've added opportunity to move around while using "Fireball"
[*]The amount of energy required for the use of the "Fireball" skill has been reduced from 15 to 1 units
[*]Damage dealt by combustion has been reduced by 10%
[*]Number of class points received for the successful hit by the "Fireball" ability has been reduced by 10%
[*]The cost of the "Fire Leap" skill has been changed from 7 Will Points to 40 units of energy [/list]

Gunner:                                                                                                         
[list]
[*]Non-blockable damage done by the "Barrel Swap" skill has been increased from 20% to 50%
[*]Now dwarven "Mobile teleporter" is triggered without delay
[*]Cooldown of the "Barrel Swap" has been changed and is now 40 seconds

Sapper:                                                                                                         
[list]
[*]Now dwarven "Mobile teleporter" is triggered without delay [/list]

Inquisitor: 
                                         
[list]
[*]The cost of using the skill "Lacerated Wounds" has been increased from 5 to 10 class points
[*]Duration of the "Lacerated Wounds" skill has been reduced from 14 to 7 seconds
[*]Damage dealt by the "Lacerated Wounds" skill has been increased by 20% [/list]

Berserker: 
                                         
[list]
[*]The time required to "exit" the Power Attack has been reduced by 0.8 seconds
[*]New ability has been added - "Brain Basher" - a sharp lunge forward with a dealing of damage to the enemy
[*]Damage from Power Attacks of Berserker has been reduced by 12%
[*]Damage dealt by the "Berserker Rage" has been decreased: on the first level of skill from 8 to 5 units, and on the second level - from 11.5 to 8
[*]Damage dealt by the "Crushing Blow" and "Mighty Sweep" skills has been increased by 14% [/list]

Paladin:

[list]
[*]Now, after the successful use of the "Resurrection" skill all the resurrected allies receive a special buff, not allowing them to die again for 0.5 seconds
[*]Health Powder and Energy Powder have been merged into one new powder - "Chimera Ashes"
[*]The "Purification" skill now cancels the effect of the Tank ability "Tremendous Roar"
[*]Cooldown of "Ring of Immortality" has been changed and is 60 seconds now
[*]Cooldown of "Resurrection" has been changed and is 60 seconds now
[*]Duration of "Holy Armor" has been reduced from 10 to 7 seconds
[*]Paladin does not spend energy for "Healing" any more
[*]During the usage of the "Healing" ability a character to be healed is now completely covered by the color health level indicationIce[/list]

Tank:
                                     
[list]
[*]Sorry, but we removed the "Battle Rage" ability
[*]But of course, instead we added new skill - "Evil Shield" - Tank attacks an enemy with a shield, pushing him/her away and dealing damage
[*]Now the characters knocked down by the "Battering Ram" receive minor damage from falling
[*]We've improved visual display of the Magical Shield for "good" and "best" graphics modes
[*]Explosions of gunpowder barrels can no longer expend the energy of the "Magical Shield" Now Tank receives a small amount of experience for blocking enemies' skills with his "Magical Shield" [/list]

Fixes:

[list]
[*]Fixed bug, when hit in the back from the turret under the "Barrel Swap" dealt double damage
[*]Fixed bug with incorrect animations of the "Siren Scream" and "Vortex of War" skills
[*]Fixed bug due to which the "Barrel Swap" ability didn't work if at the time of its activation the turret had been overheated
[*]Fixed bug due to which the chat window did not open during the battle
[*]Fixed bug due to which on maps of "Siege" and "Convoy" modes the additional time was allocated incorrectly if a control point was captured at the exact moment when the time allotted for the map expired
[*]Fixed a bug due to which visual effects of the "Holy Fire" were not displayed.[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 42
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[list]
[*]The maximum number of player in a group/party has been reduced from 8 to 3
[*]PvE mode has been completely redesigned, the size of a PvE party has reduced from 6 to 5 players
[*]Added a special chest, which can only be received on PvE locations
[*]A new type of tutorial has been added team against bots (for characters lvl 5-10)
[*]Introduction of Daily quests for both PvP and PvE modes
[*]Posebility to view broadcasts through the game client has been added
[*]New banners, emblems and accessories have been added
[*]Thematical thrones for the characters have been added, with a possibility to use them in battle.
[*]Numerical values now clearly show how much each parameter of an item is improved. You can seen it during the auto upgrade process.
[*]Decorative shields for Tanks and censers for Paladins have been added
[*]Now the equipment items (including bottles of elixirs and banners) do not interact with a character. They will not interfere with characters' movements or the construction of dwarven constructions
[*]Skills, such as "Glare Ice," "Sky Fire" and "Holy Fire", from allies are highlighted in blue and the effects of corresponding from the enemy skills - in red
[*]Access to a large number of previously inaccessible places on different maps is much easier now
[*]Now you can remove the "basic ability" from the slot on the HUD-panel and replace it with any other skill on a player's choice.
[*]When receiving a medal for the successful completion of a PvE it will brings a player some loot
[*]Now you can change abilities during the battle without waiting for the death of a character
[*]We've changed prizes for the Wheel Of the Four Gods: amulets will be replaced by keys for standard chests in an amountfrom one to five, depending on the number of days in a row played by a user [/list]

Skills & Abilities:

Ice Witch:                                                          
[list]                                                                                                                                     
[*]The aiming mechanism of the "Winter Cold" skill has been changed - now the Ice Witch freezes enemies only in front of her
[*]But we've added opportunity to move around while using the "Winter Cold" ability
[*]The amount of energy required for the use of the ability to "Frozen Sphere" has been reduced from 15 to 1 units
[*]And yes, we've added opportunity to move around while using the "Frozen Sphere" skill
[*]Amount of class points for a successful hit by the "Frozen Orb" has been reduced by 15%
[*]We've changed the "Second Wind" skill - no the Ice Witch regenerates herself and allies who are in close proximity
[*]Now the "Siren Scream" ability inflicts damage on frozen mechanisms
[*]The amount of energy needed to activate the "Freeze" ability, has been reduced from 20 to 15 units [/list]

Sister Of Fire:
                                       
[list]
[*]The "Meditation" ability has been removed
[*]Instead, we've added new skill "Battle Fervor" - Sister Of Fire significantly increases her attack speed, at the same time reducing the damage done
[*]Also, we've changed skill "Second Wind" - now Sister Of Fire regenerates herself and allies who are in close proximity
[*]And yes, we've added opportunity to move around while using "Fireball"
[*]The amount of energy required for the use of the "Fireball" skill has been reduced from 15 to 1 units
[*]Damage dealt by combustion has been reduced by 10%
[*]Number of class points received for the successful hit by the "Fireball" ability has been reduced by 10%
[*]The cost of the "Fire Leap" skill has been changed from 7 Will Points to 40 units of energy [/list]

Gunner:                                                                                                         
[list]
[*]Non-blockable damage done by the "Barrel Swap" skill has been increased from 20% to 50%
[*]Now dwarven "Mobile teleporter" is triggered without delay
[*]Cooldown of the "Barrel Swap" has been changed and is now 40 seconds

Sapper:                                                                                                         
[list]
[*]Now dwarven "Mobile teleporter" is triggered without delay [/list]

Inquisitor: 
                                         
[list]
[*]The cost of using the skill "Lacerated Wounds" has been increased from 5 to 10 class points
[*]Duration of the "Lacerated Wounds" skill has been reduced from 14 to 7 seconds
[*]Damage dealt by the "Lacerated Wounds" skill has been increased by 20% [/list]

Berserker: 
                                         
[list]
[*]The time required to "exit" the Power Attack has been reduced by 0.8 seconds
[*]New ability has been added - "Brain Basher" - a sharp lunge forward with a dealing of damage to the enemy
[*]Damage from Power Attacks of Berserker has been reduced by 12%
[*]Damage dealt by the "Berserker Rage" has been decreased: on the first level of skill from 8 to 5 units, and on the second level - from 11.5 to 8
[*]Damage dealt by the "Crushing Blow" and "Mighty Sweep" skills has been increased by 14% [/list]

Paladin:

[list]
[*]Now, after the successful use of the "Resurrection" skill all the resurrected allies receive a special buff, not allowing them to die again for 0.5 seconds
[*]Health Powder and Energy Powder have been merged into one new powder - "Chimera Ashes"
[*]The "Purification" skill now cancels the effect of the Tank ability "Tremendous Roar"
[*]Cooldown of "Ring of Immortality" has been changed and is 60 seconds now
[*]Cooldown of "Resurrection" has been changed and is 60 seconds now
[*]Duration of "Holy Armor" has been reduced from 10 to 7 seconds
[*]Paladin does not spend energy for "Healing" any more
[*]During the usage of the "Healing" ability a character to be healed is now completely covered by the color health level indicationIce[/list]

Tank:
                                     
[list]
[*]Sorry, but we removed the "Battle Rage" ability
[*]But of course, instead we added new skill - "Evil Shield" - Tank attacks an enemy with a shield, pushing him/her away and dealing damage
[*]Now the characters knocked down by the "Battering Ram" receive minor damage from falling
[*]We've improved visual display of the Magical Shield for "good" and "best" graphics modes
[*]Explosions of gunpowder barrels can no longer expend the energy of the "Magical Shield" Now Tank receives a small amount of experience for blocking enemies' skills with his "Magical Shield" [/list]

Fixes:

[list]
[*]Fixed bug, when hit in the back from the turret under the "Barrel Swap" dealt double damage
[*]Fixed bug with incorrect animations of the "Siren Scream" and "Vortex of War" skills
[*]Fixed bug due to which the "Barrel Swap" ability didn't work if at the time of its activation the turret had been overheated
[*]Fixed bug due to which the chat window did not open during the battle
[*]Fixed bug due to which on maps of "Siege" and "Convoy" modes the additional time was allocated incorrectly if a control point was captured at the exact moment when the time allotted for the map expired
[*]Fixed a bug due to which visual effects of the "Holy Fire" were not displayed.[/list]

notes.title: Announcement Patch 41 - Scheduled for 27th Jun
notes.content:
Panzarains,

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976761847.jpg[/img]

Attention! [b]Next Monday, June 27[/b] will be released long-awaited update №41! 

Therefore PANZAR server will be temporarily unavailable - [b][i]update installation will begin at 08:00 Moscow time[/i][/b] and may take several hours. We apologize for any inconvenience.

To make it less of a waiting there will be a live broadcast on RU website with Dmitry Morozov "AriOrH" he will respond to questions relating to fresh changes in the project. 

In the meantime - you, my friends, are going to see the former PANZAR and be prepare for the great changes! Stay tuned!

Note's
[list]

[*]The parameters for mana and energy have been combined into a single parameter - called energy.
[*]When using spells or abilities you will consume energy.
[*]Purple Energie runes will now increase the max energy you can have.
[*]Yellow Will Rune will increase the maximum Will value and will also generate Will.
[*]Reworked all ability that influenced mana - now all ability is working on energy.
[*]Blue elixir now restores energy.
[*]Yellow elixirs added five point Will.
[*]The logic of mana "Energy" abilities has been changed. When you run out of energy you do NOT automatically switched to the weapons.
[*]U can use block, while using Ranged Weapon
[*]Now you can turn off voice notifications in battle
[*]Added a cool down for emotions
[*]Weapons and banners of dead characters disappear after 15 seconds previously it was 30 sec.
[*]Players that are on your ignore list can't trigger an invitation to clans, friends or groups.
[*]Now, the notification about the invitation of a character to a group is displayed in the system channel
[*]After the capture of a control point on the Siege mode maps the defense will respond faster than the attacking team.
[*]We added health bars for structures (in yellow) and characters (in red)
[*]Added the opportunity to drop off all upgrades that you have put on items.
[*]The "party" system has been changed: now the difference in the characters level cannot be more than five levels
[*]From now on all configuration files will be encrypted and repackaged, this will make it impossible to use the user's own .cfg files
[*]Costumes have been added to the game: "Witch Hunter", "Free mechanic", "Salt brotherhood."
[*] The lock "Play" button has been added for players leaving the fight before it ends. The more often you desert your comrades in battle, the longer he/she has to wait for the opportunity to participate in the next.
[*]Added a new resource - the "Essence of Chaos" - from which you can create chests.
[*]Added the ability to change any resource into the resource "Essence of Chaos."
[*]Also added to the game are custom trophies, custom weapons, new costumes, banners and stickers.
[*]Leveling character to level 5 is now carried out on the training locations with bots as allies and enemy.
[*]Added effects of injuries: while reducing the amount of HP to the point when the character starts to limp, the screen darkens, the image becomes whitish. If desired, these effects can be disabled in the menu.
[*]Added switchable tips, explaining the reasons cannot be executed or that ability.
[*]Change the angle of the camera when using the Gunners ability "Barrel Rap."
[*]The term "memory" used by the player's ability or action (attack, movement, ability, etc.) is reduced to two seconds.
[*]Changed parameters of many abilities.
[*]Strips of energy and the effects do now have a purple color.
[*]The ability cool down strips have been moved below the key text.
[*]Added option to block all incoming invitations to the clans, friendship, and group.
[*]Animation when craft can now be skipped with the Enter \ Esc key
[*]Any pop-up window can now be closed with a click outside the active window.
[*]Added option to adjust the sensitivity of the mouse.
[*]Put in option enable / disable texture streaming.

Changes on locations:
[*]Added new PvP-map "Iron Trail".
[*]On the "Cannibal Stronghold" map the location of the boxes used to build a portable respawn has been changed.
[*]Recovery time for a portable respawn on "Cannibal Stronghold" after its destruction is reduced from 120 to 60 seconds
[*]On the "Elven Pier" map the disturbed bees stop attacking characters that have only 1HP left; also when the inquisitor is going into "Invisibility", the bees buff is going off him.
[*]Also we've denied access to a lot of places where a character could "get stuck"
[*]Reduced damage caused by stationary cannons on the "Alchemists' Citadel" map

Changes to skills:
[*]The aiming mechanism changed, the aiming no display operational range of the skill.
[*]For the range skills, the parabola line has been removed (with the exception of the core).
[*]Changed the required number of embedded talents to explore the different initial levels of abilities.
[*]Reduced speed getting class Points when Sisters of Fire and Paladin use skills.

Berserker:
[*]Added passive ability called "Green Fury" increases the attack speed with 10%.
[*]The ability to "Battle Rage" is replaced by the ability to "Battle Fervor" now restores some health and cost energy.
[*]The ability to "Sneaky Punch" will take 50 energy and for a short period it will prohibits the use of "Sprint" skill.
[*]The cost of "Vortex of War" skills changed and is now 50 points will.
[*]When using the Skill "Berserker Rage" two icons will be displayed. The first will shows how much energy is left to know when it will allow you to gain stacks again. The second shows the number of stacks
[*]Now, the "Berserker Rage" skills can be activated during the characters' movement

Tank:
[*]The number of levels required to unlock skill "Damage Reflection" has been reduced from 3 to 2.
[*]The number of levels needed to unlock, "Chain" ability is reduced from 3 to 2.
[*]The skill Magic Shield - now consumes energy from incoming damage.
[*]The number of levels needed to unlock, "Magic Shield" skill level 2 has been increased to 3.
[*]The equipment of the Tank has been rebalanced, now the maximum Mastery of Tanks is equal with those of other classes and is about 7751
[*]Cool down of the "Chain" ability has been increased from 5 to 10 seconds

Paladin:
[*]Deleted passive ability "Healing" now Paladin can heal directly to the right mouse button.
[*]The number of levels needed to unlock the ability "Ring of immortality" has been increased from 2 to 3.
[*]The ability "seven-league boots" now removes all slowing down effects: Gravity, Sucker Punch, and Chain.
[*]The ability "Resurrection" will now raises allies even if they were broken after freezing and 1 second of resurrection gives immunity of enemy spells control.
[*]The cost to use the ability "Ring of Immortality" has been reduced from 60 to 50 will points.
[*]The cost to use the "Purification" ability has changed and is now 20 points will. Also, when cast, the skill gives immunity to enemy control spells for 0.25 seconds
[*]The ability "Seven-league boots" now give experience to the Paladin; this is when a buffed character kills an enemy.
[*]Skill "Holy Armor" can no longer neutralize the effect of "Plague" imposed by an enemy Inquisitor

Inquisitor:
[*]The mechanism of the skill "Plague" has been changed - the spell is can't be used before you reaching 1 xp.
[*]The rate of energy recovery for the Inquisitor is increased when in stealth.
[*]Now positive "buffs" do not revile when the inquisitor is in stealth.
[*]Fetter Skill can be Blocked
[*]Cool down of the "Plague" ability has been increased up to 30 seconds
[*]Now, the "Plague" skills can be activated during the characters' movement

Sapper:
[*]At Totem place by one of the sapper - the totem now makes it possible to detect enemy Inquisitors, when they are in stealth.
[*]Added a new ability - mobile teleport.
[*]Added a new ability - Protective dome. (Action of the dome 25 seconds.)
[*]Action time of the "Steam Hammer" is now equal to 35 seconds. The construction speed of a Steam Hammer has been increased, its HP number, too, the cool down is now 30 sec
[*]The killing reward ability for Sapper has been added
[*]Cool down of the "Flash bang" ability has been increased from 20 to 30 seconds
[*]The mechanics to get class points by using Teleport has been changed - now the Sappers should have no reason to put Teleport Entrants and Exits near to each other, to receive more class points
[*]Now while you are constructing a structure on a battlefield you can see the reaching range of that structure

Gunner:
[*]Added a new ability - mobile teleport
[*]Changed the guns overheating.
[*]Changed gun cooling ability.
[*]Construction time of the Golem is 10 seconds. The effect of the Golem is increased by 2.
[*]Duration chain grenades reduced from 10 to 7 seconds.
[*]We've improved the aiming mechanism when shooting from a cannon after the "Barrel Swap"
[*]Radius of the "Chain Grenade" has been reduced and now stands at 8 meters instead of 9

Sister of Fire:
[*]Changed ability "Second Wind" (Magic silence) when used on herself and restores energy.
[*]With the skill "Flaming Curse" Add "Secondary Curse" to the explosion has been added. That is when you curse an enemy and that enemy explodes, that the allies of the enemy will get a secondary generation of curse imposed on them, in turn also inflicts damage and great pain.
[*]"Flaming Hail" ability changed. Now 50% of the damage cannot be blocked.
[*]With the ability "Fireball" it returns of 5 energy on a successful hit.
[*]Ball of Fire deals 10% less damage
[*]The "Magic Silence" has been replaced by the "Second Wind" ability. It costs 5CP, with a cool down time of 15 seconds.
[*]The efficiency of the Sister of Fire blocking attacks has been increased from 50% to 60%
[*]The number of Energie units that is added by the "Meditation" ability, increased from 15 to 20

Ice Witch:
[*]The ability "Siren Scream" changed. The first 0.5 seconds the screaming stops caste effects in the area.
[*]The ability to "Frozen Sphere" now does 10% less damage.
[*]Using the "Winter Cold" is consumes 20 Energy, the spell effect lasts 6 seconds
[*]The skill "magical silence" has been replaced with a new ability to "Second Wind", which consumes Points Will and recovers 50 + 50% of the maximum amount of energy from the caster
[*]Skills "Astral" can no longer neutralize the effect of "Plague" imposed by an enemy Inquisitor
[*]The "Magic Silence" has been replaced by the "Second Wind" ability. It costs 3CP and a cool down of 25 seconds.

Changes to improve things:
[*]Added "Auto Enhance".
[*]Changed the mechanism of Horseshoe Good luck - now the Horseshoe is a consumable object and each time spent in selecting improvement if placed in the appropriate slot.

Chests:
[*]The game introduces a new type of object - "Chest", from which you can obtain different items and custom items. Chests are of three types: normal, rare and costume (also three species) .Right Click to open with keys.
[*]Hats have been removed from the store and added to the chests.
[*]In the store a new section has been added for the chests, keys and key rings.
[*]In the inventory of characters, a new section for the chests and keys.
[*]The player obtained all sorts of chests and keys after the fight.

Bug Fixing:
[*]Now the not cancelable skills really cannot be undone.
[*]When using the "Crushing Blow" skill a character is turning correctly.
[*]Game Client loaded much faster.
[*]Fixed bug that caused you to spawn in pre-battle at the 0 coordinates (Endless falling in the pre-round).
[*]Change font of text in the character information.
[*]Fixed many bugs that led to the Game client crash
[*]Blockbuster now acts on frozen enemies.
[*]Fixed issue with incorrect display of number of crystals between in the game value and the value on the website.

notes.title: New Map with Update 34
notes.content:
[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/lnc_028.jpg[/img]

Update #34 is simmering on the fires of chaos and the Studios are preparing a brand new map for our Panzarians. This time, we are heading into the earthy caves of the underground dwelling Dwarves, with our brand new “King of the Hill” mode.  
 
We like to keep it fresh! Last update, we brought you PvE mode and a brand new map. This time we are offering you a totally new PANZAR experience in the dark, enclosed caverns of this vertically-challenged race. You are going to get the chance to test one of our hopefully more brilliant ideas - and if you like it enough, we might even consider renovating ‘Toxic Bay’ too. 


[img]http://www.panzar.ru/images/gallery/DwarfUndergrounds_09.jpg[/img]

“Mines of Kromholm” will give Panzarians a chance to fight it out on 3 murky underground levels deep in the heart of the mountain where hides the mother of invention. Take a second to admire the granite stairs, majestic bridges, wacky creations, unbreakable columns and artful transport systems in the calm before the storm.

The new mode is more of a fusion between our existing " King of the Hill " and " Mechanism ". It all starts in the center of the Great Hall , located equidistantly from the two opposing teams. As the match progresses, the mechanism will be randomly transferred to another one of the seven points on the map. Teams and players must be ready to react, but fear not, loud sirens will wail the alert when it’s time to move on, but not until one of the teams gains the upper hand in the bloody carnage there first. 

[img]http://www.panzar.ru/images/gallery/DwarfUndergrounds_03.jpg[/img]

The mechanism will be subjected to several dynamic changes in a few different places in order to get the team from the start location to the point of interest within the same period of time. By the way, it will take a little longer for the team that owns the point than the attackers, because defending is a little easier. First team to 500 points will be declared victorious.

In the meantime, you can stave off the impatience on the forum, where we have put most of the patch notes already.

[img]http://www.panzar.ru/images/gallery/DwarfUndergrounds_11.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 33: Learn Panzar Basics
notes.content:
<center>[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/lnc_009.jpg[/img]<center>

The merge is here and has unleashed happy linguistic chaos on the adrenaline packed battles with ultra rapid match-making mechanics. Not to mention the level cap, which opens up the new whole new world of level 30 to Panzarians: that’s 10 new levels, new Epics, extra Amulet slots and new Skills.
 
As we open our eyes to the brand new Panzar world, it’s time to discover what will be coming up in the next patch, creatively called “Update 33”. 
 
SKILLS VIDEOS

We have heard that Panzar game mechanics are difficult to understand for new players. This patch is going to change this. We are making tutorial videos that show you exactly what your character can do. These videos can be watched in the Panzar game client. They will show you exactly what each skill looks like and what it’s for. With this information, players can make the right decision when spending their precious Skill Points at the Panzar Altar.

<center><iframe width="560" height="315" src="//www.youtube.com/embed/4zWE8HKuoVE" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe><center>

 
UPGRADES

And the Panzarians chanted: “We want a confirmation box before we upgrade.” When our players demand, we listen. No more 0.1 point upgrades. We got it. With “Update 33”, there will be no more finger slips or mistakes, the Panzar game client will ask you to accept your upgrade in a special confirmation box before anything is changed. 

<center>[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/5.jpg[/img]

THE FORGE

Yes. We like to improve Panzar’s Forge. Every patch makes the crafting system a little bit different and a little bit better: perfection is 99% effort and only 1% luck. We have a different Recipe List. It will no longer appear in blocks organised by level. Instead you will have a list of everything you can craft at that moment from weapons to armour. New players can even watch a video tutorial, they just have to click on the button. You can see some screenshots of the new Forge below. 


<center>[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/4.jpg[/img]<center>


<center>[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/3.jpg[/img]<center>

Head to our [url=http://www.panzar.com/forum/]forum[/url]where nothing is taboo. Tell us what you like. Tell us what you want. You demand. We listen. It’s all here.

notes.title: Update 33: The Killcam Afterlife
notes.content:
<center>[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/lnc_008.jpg[/img]<center>

Our “Update 33” saga continues here! Next up on our innovation list is the…
 
KILLCAM
The KillCam is what you see when you die. Until now, Panzarians watched their dead character lie on the battle ground. Their corpses were beaten, kicked and moved by the surviving warriors. You waited for respawn. We said: “No More!”. 
 
FOLLOW THE BATTLE
With our new Update 33, you can unstick the camera from your character and follow a living teammate and see the battle through his eyes. We are sure this will appeal to our tournament and clan players.
 
FOR PvE
And it’s not only for PvP - it may be extra important for our upcoming PvE mode. In this game mode, death may last up to 90 secs if no one resurrects you. So if you’re dead and waiting, you can use the KillCam to help your living teammates coordinate their strategy. And this is how it will look:

<center><iframe width="560" height="315" src="//www.youtube.com/embed/WawVya16-IQ" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe></center>

We have some great other visuals for you too. For example, instead of a boring “Victory” screen (or even worse “Defeat”), you will get an animated result announcement instead - like this, just in your language: 

<center><iframe width="560" height="315" src="//www.youtube.com/embed/Sh2yktjS-m8" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe><center>

BATTLE VALUE
 
Let’s start at the beginning: Battle Value. This is a fundamental element of balance and match-making. It is what decides who you play with in public matches and explains why a level 15 player can play with/against level 21. Actually level isn’t that important, but a whole lot of things are.
 
BV MATHS & BALANCE
 
What makes your Battle Value? The BV is calculated using your level, equipment (armour, weapons, runes, upgrades), player rating (matches lost/won/etc.) as well as your character skills and abilities. The total of all these numbers is your Battle Value. The maths are simple: the better you play, the better your stuff, etc. - the higher your BV. This is why you play in battles with people of a higher level. It’s also why some fully geared max level players (especially now match-making is improved) are fighting lower level players.
 
SHOW ME THE BV
 
“Level 20 against level 12. There’s no game balance. Booo. Panzar needs better balance mechanics.” We’ve all heard it - we’ve all read it - and we, the Panzar Crew, totally disagree. This is why “Update 33” has a new Battle Table after each match. It will show you your BV and all the other players too. You deserve to see your battle value, and you will.
